category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: In the morning, Lord, You hear my voice.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and He hears me.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: I cry to You for help, Lord; in the morning my prayer comes before You.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in Your word.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Let the morning bring me word of Your unfailing love.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Very early in the morning... Jesus got up, left the house and went to a solitary place.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: When you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: He went up on a mountainside by Himself to pray.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek You.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: But seek first His kingdom and His righteousness.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: God did this so that they would seek Him and perhaps reach out for Him.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Look to the Lord and His strength; seek His face always.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Look to the Lord and His strength; seek His face always.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: If my people... will humble themselves and pray and seek my face.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Your face, Lord, I will seek.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: For it is time to seek the Lord, until He comes.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Seek me and live.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Seek the Lord, all you humble of the land.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: You who seek God, may your hearts live!

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Blessed are those... who seek Him with all their heart.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Those who seek the Lord understand it fully.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: The Lord is good to those whose hope is in Him, to the one who seeks Him.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: If you seek Him, He will be found by you.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: If you seek Him, He will be found by you.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to Him.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: You, Lord, have never forsaken those who seek You.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Seek the Lord while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: There is no one who understands; there is no one who seeks God.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Blessed are those who dwell in Your house; they are ever praising You.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: One thing I ask from the Lord... to dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: And I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Blessed are those You choose and bring near to live in Your courts.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Lord, who may dwell in Your sacred tent?

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: I long to dwell in Your tent forever.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Lord, I love the house where You live, the place where Your glory dwells.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: And His resting place will be glorious.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: I will remain quiet and will look on from my dwelling place.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: My people will live in peaceful dwelling places, in secure homes.

category: Category 3: Sitting Quietly in His Presence
verse_text: Remain in me, as I also remain in you.
